name: Synanceia

perks.name: Hungry Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.desc: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Honed Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage.

perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.desc: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Tempered Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage and ammo.

perks.name: Balanced Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has balanced overall defenses.

perks.name: Burst Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.

perks.name: Enduring Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.

perks.name: Heavy Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.

perks.name: Swordmaster's Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.desc: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Assassin's Blade
perks.desc: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage.

perks.name: Sharp Harvest
perks.desc: Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants special ammo.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Eager Edge
perks.desc: Gain increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage, reload speed, and handling until the wielder's death.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 153 from 9 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6iEksMDGzT5euNuMAEqnVm?si=a9bf49987cdb441a) with @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility roll for movement tech in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Synanceia is a wave frame, so the heavy wave attack costs 4 ammo with an extra 1 for the optional targeted follow-up. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats look good - Impact and Charge Rate are both highest in the subfamily, and they're improved further at Tier 4/5 when blade and guard perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/1823308496 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Base total ammo is 66 (max 77). Normally we'd use the blade perk to maximise damage but, as this is an Eager Edge roll, the more ammo you have, the more sword lunges. And, for this particular roll, the guard perk doesn't really matter. The first trait perk column doesn't have anything that directly helps with Eager Edge but, if you're using this against adds it might as well do something useful. Sharp Harvest returns 5% of special ammo reserves for 3 hits within ~1.5s (~2.0s when enhanced), Relentless Strikes returns 1 ammo if you get 3 hits within ~2s of each other (~2.5s when enhanced) or Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after 10 hits within 5s of each other - hits with the wave attack count towards the counter. Really, all of this is just the delivery system for a Edge of Fate featured Eager Edge sword that provides a ×1.8 increased grounded lunge and ×1.64 airborne lunge (×2 and ×1.8 when enhanced) for 3s after readying. The Tenacity Origin trait stacks up to ×20 on kills, providing an extra 0.5% damage per stack (max ×1.1 damage boost) until you die. It also boosts Handling and Reload Speed with each stack, which aren't weapon attributes on a sword, so there may possibly be a small boost to Charge Rate. There's also Häkke Breach Armaments - if you want to attack a tank, turret or Shrieker with a sword then good luck with that! If you're interested, Synanceia is the scientific genus for stonefish, which are venomous, marine ray-finned fish found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters and the Red Sea. These fish are known for their camouflage, resembling rocks, and possess potent neurotoxins in their dorsal spines that can cause severe pain, paralysis, and even death in humans. Recommended MW: Impact, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 153 from 9 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6iEksMDGzT5euNuMAEqnVm?si=a9bf49987cdb441a) with @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility roll for CQC Boss damage in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Synanceia is a wave frame, so the heavy wave attack costs 4 ammo with an extra 1 for the optional targeted follow-up. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats look good - Impact and Charge Rate are both highest in the subfamily, and they're improved further at Tier 4/5 when blade and guard perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/1823308496 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Base total ammo is 66 (max 77). Use the blade perk to maximise damage and Swordmaster's Guard guard perk improves Charge Rate by +10 for the heavy attack. Swords may not be the current meta for boss damage, but if you want to tuck away a roll just in case, Relentless Strikes returns 1 ammo if you get 3 hits within ~2s of each other (~2.5s when enhanced) to improve ammo economy or Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after 10 hits within 5s of each other to proc armor mods. The second column damage perk is more situational - if there are 3+ adds within 15m, Surrounded procs to boost damage by up to ×1.35 (×1.4175 when enhanced). On a Transcendent subclass Elemental Honing grants an escalating stack of damage up to ×1.35 for 20s (23s enhanced) for each elemental damage type inflicted, which can be refreshed with a new damage type until you've run through all 5. On a solar build, Burning Ambition works better to build ignitions on tougher targets if you apply scorch with an ability initially, otherwise it'll take a few hits to apply +20 stacks, with +20 added on each additional hit to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. For shorter damage windows, Binary Orbit provides a ×1.25 damage boost for 8.5s (10.5s enhanced) on any elemental kill of the opposite type. The Tenacity Origin trait stacks up to ×20 on kills, providing an extra 0.5% damage per stack (max ×1.1 damage boost) until you die. It also boosts Handling and Reload Speed with each stack, which aren't weapon attributes on a sword, so there may possibly be a small boost to Charge Rate. There's also Häkke Breach Armaments - if you want to attack a tank, turret or Shrieker with a sword then good luck with that! If you're interested, Synanceia is the scientific genus for stonefish, which are venomous, marine ray-finned fish found in tropical Indo-Pacific waters and the Red Sea. These fish are known for their camouflage, resembling rocks, and possess potent neurotoxins in their dorsal spines that can cause severe pain, paralysis, and even death in humans.
